svg.title: How the toolkit fits together
svg.desc: How the toolkit fits together. 15 components in 3 groups. Connections: Any public repo to Repo Analyzer (REST API); Your repo to Cost Audit Action (pull request); Your repo to claude-rate; Your repo to VS Code extension; ~/.claude to claude-rate (--user --usage); Cost Audit Action to Grade and badge; Repo Analyzer to Grade and badge; Badge Checker to Grade and badge; claude-rate to Grade and badge; claude-rate to Cost estimate; Cost Calculator to Cost estimate; VS Code extension to Cost estimate; MCP cost server to Cost estimate; cost-mode skill to In-session nudges; Budget hooks to In-session nudges.

text.tspan: What each tool reads, where it runs and what it gives back
